proved_here: A real, schema-valid income-tax TrinityBundle and bound input artifacts compile through the canonical Foundry compiler to persisted exec-plan and lowered-IR artifacts.
Scientist replay selects FOUNDRY, calls the real execute_foundry implementation exactly once, and persists a foundry.simulation_result plus post-execution state snapshot.

A fresh process in a distinct scratch cwd under policy-engine/_build resolves and validates the simulation result and state snapshot from CAS using the explicit leaf-source PYTHONPATH; observed income is [90, 180, 270] and government balance is 60, matching an independently calculated 10-percent tax oracle.
Absent plan ref, corrupted plan bytes, and removed-executor controls each reject replay; the failure/removal controls cannot pass from the presence of a stored result marker.

Direct Scientist/root/compatibility import identity, exact ten root names, exact twenty transitional exports, delayed CLI import, dynamic inventory, benchmark consumer, unknown-name refusal, and a fresh installed-wheel smoke with package-origin check are covered. The installed-wheel audit independently confirms identity and inspect.signature equality for all ten root exports plus all twenty shim exports.
not_established_or_still_required_for_fu: The full bundle import/export plus actual replay/resume CLI acceptance is not established by this slice; existing REP tests cover persisted --check-only and a resume dry-run, not the complete bundle/import/export/replay/resume matrix.
No complete external caller census or zero-traffic claim is established; retain the finding's not_established boundary for unsupported external reflection/string imports.
This test run does not independently prove historical v1.1 bytes or the distinct versioned v2 identity behavior. No production serialization or compatibility bytes were changed.

The wheel smoke installs with --no-deps into a fresh Python 3.14 venv using system_site_packages=True; it proves installed package resolution and replay ABI imports, not isolated dependency resolution.

bounded_property_vs_proxy.property: Replay executes the compiled Foundry plan and returns a persisted result whose downstream state matches the declared input and policy.
bounded_property_vs_proxy.prior_proxy: A Foundry replay test monkeypatched _execute_foundry_replay to return a stored simulation-result ref; BIT_EXACT verification only compares original and replay result IDs.
bounded_property_vs_proxy.divergent_case: A packet with no simulation_result_ref can appear successful if the executor simply returns an unrelated stored result ref; equal IDs alone do not establish execution or output correctness.
bounded_property_vs_proxy.distinguishing_probe: This test begins without simulation_result_ref, wraps and delegates to the real execute_foundry, then reads the typed result and state snapshot in a fresh process and checks the independent arithmetic oracle; the executor-removal falsifier must fail.
bounded_property_vs_proxy.verification_mode: replay_packet(..., verify=False) is deliberate: the packet contains no prior result ID. The independent fresh-process CAS readback is the semantic oracle; no claim is made that BIT_EXACT itself verifies numerical behavior.
